status: exploratory reanalysis of previously inspected data
source_population: all 210692 eligible natural cases; no intervention-source sampling
late_temporal: 70/15/15 sorted decision_time and source ID; original-D1 target
early_temporal: 90-day target; training Jan-Mar 2018, calibration Apr-May 2018, test Sep 2018; latest calibration horizon ends before test begins
ood_split: top 1% absolute PO exposure held out; lower 99% hash split 70/15/15 including ID test
selection: Refit isotonic for each of 20 calibration-half seeds; train model fixed. Candidates are distinct fitted isotonic y thresholds, independent of selection labels; descending fixed sequence stops at first failure.

graph.stop: first failed exact binomial test in each increasing-budget chain

costs: dimensionless; cH=.10, rhoH=0, cA=.50; fixed-decision repricing distinguished from RCSE retuning
nonlinear: sklearn histogram gradient boosting: 180 trees, learning_rate=.05, max_leaf_nodes=31, min_samples_leaf=30, L2=1; no hyperparameter search; train-only category vocabulary, top 253 plus other
guarantee: Within each reported family and seed only, under IID natural-case assumptions. No simultaneous guarantee over seeds/families, no shift guarantee, no capture-completeness claim.
learned_start: First isotonic-fitting half chooses a starting candidate using an in-sample binomial heuristic, not a certificate. The independent selection half certifies the resulting fixed sequence at delta=.05.
